questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct method to construct an equilateral triangle with side length 4 cm?
choices: Draw a base of 4 cm, then draw a line of 4 cm from one end and another line of 4 cm from the other end
Draw a base of 4 cm, then draw two arcs of 4 cm from each end to find the third vertex
Draw a base of 4 cm, then draw a perpendicular line from the midpoint of the base and measure 4 cm up
Draw a base of 4 cm, then mark a point 4 cm away from one end and 4 cm away from the other end without drawing arcs
questions.solution: The correct method is to draw a base of 4 cm, then draw two arcs of 4 cm from each end to find the third vertex. This ensures that the third vertex is at the correct distance from both ends, forming an equilateral triangle. The other options either skip the step of drawing arcs or suggest drawing lines directly without using the arcs, which would not ensure the correct distances.

questions.stem: In a triangle, if one angle is 140°, and the other two angles are equal, what is the measure of each of the other two angles?
questions.solution: The sum of the angles in a triangle is 180°. So, the sum of the other two angles is 180° - 140° = 40°. Since they are equal, each is 40° / 2 = 20°. The option 30° is incorrect because it assumes the remaining sum is 60°. The option 40° is incorrect because it assumes one of the angles is 40°. The option 50° is incorrect because it assumes the remaining sum is 100°.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज में, यदि एक कोण 140° है, और अन्य दो कोण बराबर हैं, तो अन्य दो कोणों में से प्रत्येक का माप क्या है?
hi.solution: त्रिभुज के कोणों का योग 180° होता है। इसलिए, अन्य दो कोणों का योग 180° - 140° = 40° है। चूंकि वे बराबर हैं, प्रत्येक 40° / 2 = 20° है। 30° विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि यह मान लेता है कि शेष योग 60° है। 40° विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि यह मान लेता है कि एक कोण 40° है। 50° विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि यह मान लेता है कि शेष योग 100° है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: त्रिकोणात जर एक कोन 140° असेल आणि इतर दोन कोन समान असतील, तर इतर दोन कोनांपैकी प्रत्येकाचे माप किती असेल?
mr.solution: त्रिकोणाच्या कोनांची बेरीज 180° असते. म्हणून, इतर दोन कोनांची बेरीज 180° - 140° = 40° असेल. त्यांना समान मानल्यास, प्रत्येक 40° / 2 = 20° असेल. 30° ची निवड चुकीची आहे कारण ती उरलेल्या बेरीजला 60° मानते. 40° ची निवड चुकीची आहे कारण ती एका कोनाला 40° मानते. 50° ची निवड चुकीची आहे कारण ती उरलेल्या बेरीजला 100° मानते.

questions.stem: If two circles of the same size intersect at two points, how many equilateral triangles can be formed using the centers and the intersection points?
questions.solution: When two circles of the same size intersect at two points, the centers of the circles and the two intersection points form two equilateral triangles. The correct option states that two equilateral triangles can be formed. The other options are incorrect because only two equilateral triangles can be formed, not one, three, or four.

questions.stem: If three lengths satisfy the triangle inequality, what can be said about the existence of a triangle with those lengths?
choices: A triangle can always be constructed.
A triangle may or may not be constructed.
A triangle cannot be constructed.
A triangle can only be constructed if the lengths are equal.
questions.solution: If three lengths satisfy the triangle inequality, a triangle can always be constructed. This is because the condition ensures that the arcs drawn from the endpoints of the longest side will intersect, allowing the third vertex to be formed. The other options are incorrect because they either contradict the triangle inequality or make incorrect assumptions about the construction process.
